task.title: Publish Chimera GitHub repo (public)
task.description: Push existing Chimera codebase to public GitHub. Use existing chimera-README.md and chimera-ARCHITECTURE.md from VDR. Doesn't need to be perfect — needs to exist. Community building starts at publish, not at polish.
